name: Hyperspace
description: Space-opera look: starfields, gold titles, cyan cockpit brackets and glowing energy-blade rules. Hyperspace streak transitions, an opening text crawl, a glowing Versus card and a holographic flicker on the lower thirds. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
